name: listTableRecords
description:
Lists records of a Tulip Table, with optional sorting, filtering and column selection. Corresponds to GET /tables/{tableId}/records. Requires `tables:read` scope. [READ-ONLY]

The API returns 10 records by default and at most 100 per request; limits up to 1000 are fetched as several pages. Page further with offset. Without sortOptions the order is the API default (oldest first); for the latest records pass sortOptions [{"sortBy":"_createdAt","sortDir":"desc"}]. To count records, use countTableRecords or runTableAggregation rather than counting returned rows.

tableId.description: The ID of the table to list records from

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-1000, API default 10). Above 100 the server is paged automatically.

offset.description: Number of records to skip (for paging).

sortOptions.description: Sort order, in priority order. Example: [{"sortBy":"_createdAt","sortDir":"desc"}]

field.description: Column name (from getTable .columns[].name), or a built-in such as _createdAt.

arg.description: Value to compare to. Omit for 'blank' and 'notBlank'. Numbers and booleans may be sent as text; they are converted to the column's type. For isIn/notIsIn give a comma list ("A,B") or a JSON array. Interval values are in seconds. For timestamps use an ISO 8601 string.

fields.description: Only return these columns (names from getTable .columns[].name). Omit for all columns.

includeTotalCount.description: Also report how many records match the filters in total.
